cells.quote: We find that the mindset intervention has a positive average eﬀect of 0.26, 95%-CI [0.22, 0.30], and that heterogeneity in the range of [0 .1, 0.4] is moderated by school-level achievement level, poverty concentration, urbanicity, and student prior expectations.
cells.note: The study describes the dataset and analysis as observational; treatment was assigned at student level, but random assignment is not stated.

O.outcome_detail: imputed conditional average treatment effect moderated by school mindset and student expectations

result.effect: CATE values 0.18–0.33 in the X1-by-S3 regression-tree leaves

cells.quote: In the right-hand ﬁgure,S3 (student’s expectations) appears associated with a larger eﬀect only if the average mindset of the school is suﬃciently high. This pattern disappears when using a linear model.
cells.note: This is a post-workshop regression-tree analysis of imputed CATEs; the authors caution that school-level patterns have high variance.
